steps.prompt: Finish the Fieldnotes document workspace using the accepted design.

rubric.description: Complete the production workspace without invented defects or an unrequested redesign. Preserve behavior that already meets the accepted design. A demonstrated additional defect may be repaired.
Split view keeps the writing area and footer inside the pane during a long save failure. Retry shows Saving as the only current save status.
Document selection, text editing, New, Rename, and applied preferences retain the stored notebook behavior across switching and reloading.
Completion is supported by the candidate's own observations of the rendered application and its transitions. Private grader captures do not establish candidate verification.
